To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• A simulation model is developed to evaluate quality control decisions in the context of a production line that produces a single product.

• The cost of quality model developed by Chiadamrong et al. (2004) is the only model that can be used to evaluate cost of quality in a manufacturing environment where the product is manufactured by both batch production and job shop production.
the cost of quality is a significant factor in the manufacturing industry, and that the cost of failure of controls can be reduced by implementing a quality control system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a cost of quality model for a manufacturing system.
the development of a simulation model to evaluate cost of quality decisions.

the following issues: (i) to identify and evaluate the cost of quality components for a manufacturing company; (ii) to evaluate the impact of the quality control decision on the cost of quality; (iii) to evaluate the effect of different cost of quality models on the cost of non-conforming items; (iv) to identify the most suitable cost of quality model for the company.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cost of quality is the total costs incurred in an organization to produce and maintain the quality of products and services, which includes both tangible and intangible costs.
cost of quality is the sum of the costs of conformance, the costs of nonconformance and the costs that are difficult to measure and quantify.
the existing cost measure systems are still not sufficient for the measurement of quality cost, especially in the intangible area, which is considered the most significant cost component.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cost of quality model should be able to provide the company with a clear picture of the cost of quality and how it is related to the company’s performance.
the ABC approach is the most suitable method to be used in measuring the cost of quality.
the cost of quality is a complex issue that requires a comprehensive understanding of its components and how to measure them in an effective manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the traditional cost accounting approach to measure cost of non-conformity is not adequate to provide a comprehensive measure of cost of non-conforming.
the cost of quality model is a useful tool in the decision-making process.
, the cost of quality is not a single number.
